notes.title: GAME UPDATE ! :)
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333202/c3cd3b2fe9e642064ed4b5d6450c1dcb1aeaabf5.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333202/749ea40d575abcd5a59ab040b7caaa19f795f175.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Dear Players,[/b][/p][p]I would like to thank you sincerely for spending your time with my game.
It is both an honor and a great pleasure to know that you found it entertaining and worthy of your precious time.[/p][p]With this update, I finally had the chance to add some new pots to the game (a bit more complex than usual). I hope they will bring you even more fun and relaxation.
I also redesigned the controls UI. I know the old version was quite a nightmare to understand, so I believe this one will serve you much better. Please use it to discover how hints work, as well as new ways of placing pieces during the game.[/p][p]The more challenging modes will stay as they are meant to be, but now you will also have additional ways to enjoy and explore the gameplay.[/p][p]Once again, many thanks for your time and fantastic support.[/p][p]All the best,
[b]Adam[/b][/p][p][b]P.S.[/b][/p][p]There are more pots and elements planned for future updates.[/p]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333202/a92591254ce051f47dd7a695caba1d7a023f3d3e.jpg[/img]

notes.title: GAME UPDATE ! 13-04-2025 V2
notes.content:
diffuculty ui button could have set invalid icon regarding difficulty level, this has been fixed
also difficulty description has been made even more descriptive so player will know wjhat to expect.
New hint option for rotated pieces.
Playing at NORMAL and DIFFICULT levels will be backed by "rotation hint".
The more piece is far from valid orientation the more red outline of the selected piece will be.
If piece is rotateed towards valid rotation, outline color will shift towards green color.
If piece is at the correct orientation ( inside given threshold value ) outline will be turned off.
From now on, all you have to do is to find correct spot :)
With this update this game is finnaly playable by me :D
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333202/8db6b8f32ef8e62945025f19ab6e60ce416ffdc2.gif[/img]

Many thanks for playing :)
Adam

notes.title: EASY MODE JUST GOT EASIER ! :)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333202/d8f7013cb56ef6f4de996ecc8eda8c6fd5ba67a3.png[/img]
I believe difficulty in games should always be the player's choice. A good game should be easy to pick up but also provide a challenge for those who seek it—whether to test their skills, willpower, focus, or simply to enjoy the same experience as others but with a greater sense of accomplishment. Simple as that!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333202/ea6ff640c37e4080dba04abdb548b104c412949f.gif[/img]
In KINTSUGI, the easy mode is truly easy - designed to make you feel comfortable, relaxed… or even a little lazy if you want. It's entirely up to you!

The gradual increase in difficulty gives you the freedom to decide how much of a challenge you want to take on. Kintsugi, as an form of art, is demanding, and this game is just a simplified interpretation of it.
That's why it should be not harder to play than you want it to be :)
Higher difficulty modes can really put your abilities to the test. 
Based on my own experience woth it ( I play every day :D ), though, it's worth it!

And that's coming from someone who's generally terrible at puzzles :D

I hope you will enjoy the game - even on the harder modes :)
All The Best
Adam.

notes.title: TWO CONVENIENT WAYS FOR PIECE PLACEMENT :)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333202/2b10567d14cb57c7286c2efc0e10d5ba2eb7128f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333202/e4a1d5dc3114f519ee0e55af73ad7ae1ace3c4fa.gif[/img]
With "mode OUT" placing pieces is as usual, you see them from the same point of view as piece being placed.
This might cause some issues if some pieces needs to be placed with precision.
To make such process more straightforward ( and less guess work involved ) there is alternate method:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333202/018b41db922d4d3c6cf1d619b698d48fef8b322f.gif[/img]
"mode IN: ;) This one allows you to see and place pieces while they are at opposite side of your point of view :)
This will make more tight places more accessible and assembly proces will be way more convenient and "to the point" :)
You can swap between modes at any time, depending on the "situation" pick the one more suiting effortless placement :)
How ?? :D With "C" on keyboard or "RB" on gamepad, at your convenience :)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333202/617c7771906aa5b9afdbd296bd7654f17a864729.png[/img]
Also, there is a small improvement for camera navigation. Now you can ZOOM IN really close, great for more demanding assembly levels.
All The Best
Adam.
